{{Quote|Ever notice how some people always seem as fresh as Jovarian sun ferns, even after the most demanding day? Or what about those who brave the heat of Varadan's twin suns and never seem to perspire?|Advertisement for the CSC-5000 body glove in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
The '''Jovarian sun fern''' was a type of [[Fern (plant)/Legends|fern]]<ref name="Galladinium" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Jovaria system/Legends|Jovaria system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> an advertisement for the [[Kamperdine Clothing Specialists/Legends|Kamperdine Clothing Specialists']] climate-controlled [[CSC-5000]] [[Body glove/Legends|body glove]] in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'' made a rhetorical inquiry of whether the [[Datalog/Legends|datalog's]] reader had ever noticed any individuals who had appeared to be as "fresh" as Jovarian [[Star/Legends|sun]] ferns, with the implication that such people were using the CSC-5000.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jovarian sun fern was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
